_notes: Sheet 178 of the tournament savegame (8x4, its own FaceURL), read card by card from the image on 2026-11-02. CardID = 17800 + idx; 17700 = the character card, a sheet of its own (177, 1x1) inside the same physical deck, which is why the catalog lists two images and card_ids 17700..17829.

unmatched-memory files the hero as `harry-houdini` (`memory_slug`) and names it 'Harry Houdini'; the hero card, the miniature and the cards read HOUDINI (`name`), the sparring slug is the catalog's `houdini`.

Restriction band (HOUDINI, BESS or ANY) and copies (xN) read from the images. HOUDINI on The Big Reveal, An Illusion Of My Own Design, Vanishing Act, Grand Escape and A Magician Never Reveals His Secrets; BESS on And The Beautiful Bess! and Set The Stage; ANY on the other six titles.
Hero card (read from the image): HOUDINI, MELEE, START HEALTH 14, MOVE 2; sidekick BESS, MELEE, START HEALTH 5 (move 2 from unmatched-memory: the hero card prints no move for the sidekick).

Discrepancy with unmatched-memory (the real card wins): An Illusion Of My Own Design prints BOOST 1, unmatched-memory says 2 (`boost` below overrides it). The BOOSTED WITH text of the six cards that have one is appended to the card text by the importer (`effectBoost`).
ESCAPE ARTIST stays as data here; the interpreter reads the `maneuver_boost_places_hero` rule of data/heroes/effects/houdini.json.
